SIMple Academy · Meet your facilitator

Hello, I'm Dr Rajkumar Elanjeran.

Emergency Physician · Simulation Educator

I've spent years teaching and facilitating medical simulation, and one question keeps coming back to me: why should learning be something we just watch?

I created this module because I believe in self-directed, active learning. Instead of sitting through another series of videos, you'll explore the theory at your own pace, interact with ideas and test what you actually understand. You'll see short healthcare examples along the way, but the theory comes first.

Read. Explore. Think. Try. And learn for yourself.
